registers.title: Flags (F)
rows: Undocumented: a copy of bit 5 of the result
Half carry: out of bit 3, for DAA
Undocumented: a copy of bit 3 of the result
Parity (logic, rotates) or overflow (arithmetic); IFF2 for LD A, I and LD A, R
Subtract: the last operation was a subtraction, for DAA
